runs.notesForRun: Destructive criteria reset authorised by user. Fresh scan only: public unauthenticated Zoopla newest-first pages 1/2 controlled dates (26 Sep–2 Oct) across all 14 target postcodes; every 2/3-bed OnTheMarket postcode facet was also opened for live-stock coverage. Excluded shared ownership, Homewise/lifetime/retirement, stale/relisted/reduced, mismarketed, promoted out-of-postcode and over-budget stock. Ten retained inspected open-market candidates; details/facts and floorplan tabs were checked. OnTheMarket has no reliable date sort, so it did not control freshness.

zoopla-74361094.address: Winchester Road, Highams Park, London E4
zoopla-74361094.description: Chain-free two-bedroom mid-terrace period home in Highams Park. It has a through lounge, two bedrooms, first-floor bathroom and scope to modernise and extend (subject to planning); the station, village centre and Highams Park Lake are nearby.

pros: Freehold period house at the budget ceiling
Highams Park station is moments away with direct Liverpool Street trains
Through lounge and extension potential
Chain free
cons: Needs modernisation, so acquisition price is not the full project cost
Only one bathroom and no stated floorplan measurements beyond 938 sq ft

zoopla-74365959.tenure: Leasehold (term ask agent; £1,440 pa service charge, £10 ground rent)
zoopla-74365959.description: Third-floor purpose-built two-bedroom flat with a bright reception, separate fitted kitchen, two double bedrooms, bathroom and separate WC. The listing places it moments from Hackney Downs and Hackney Central.

pros: Well below budget
Two double bedrooms and separate kitchen
Short walk to Hackney Downs and Hackney Central
cons: Third floor and no lift mentioned
Lease term is unpublished
Interchange journey caps score at 7

zoopla-74375451.tenure: Share of freehold (£100 pa ground rent; service charge ask agent)
zoopla-74375451.description: First-floor share-of-freehold apartment in Dalston with open-plan kitchen/reception, a generously sized bedroom, second bedroom, contemporary bathroom, engineered wood floors and Juliet balconies to the reception and bedroom.

pros: Share of freehold at the budget ceiling
Dalston Kingsland and Junction are both walkable
Juliet balconies and contemporary finish
cons: Service charge is unpublished
Interchange commute is not direct
Listing description is inconsistent about bedroom sizing

zoopla-74372817.description: Immaculately finished 842 sq ft Victorian duplex with dedicated entrance, open-plan skylit kitchen/reception, two double bedrooms, bathroom, storage and a private south-facing garden. The listing says Leyton tube is ten minutes on foot.

pros: 842 sq ft, private south-facing garden and dedicated entrance
Chain free and described as finished to a high standard
Within the requested station-walk standard
cons: At the budget ceiling
Lease, ground rent and service charge are unpublished
Walk plus line journey is borderline and cannot score above 7

zoopla-74372673.tenure: Leasehold (242 years; £3,374 pa service charge; £400 ground rent)
zoopla-74372673.description: 823 sq ft second-floor new-build apartment with two bedrooms, two bathrooms, lift access, wide doorways and a generous balcony. Walthamstow Queen’s Road station is on the doorstep.

pros: 823 sq ft, two bathrooms, lift and balcony
Very short station walk and direct Overground route
Long 242-year lease
cons: £3,374 annual service charge plus £400 ground rent materially increases ownership cost
New-build flat rather than a house
Ground-rent review date unpublished

zoopla-74365640.address: Vaudeville Court, St Thomas's Road, Finsbury Park, London N4
zoopla-74365640.tenure: Leasehold (term, service charge and ground rent ask agent)
zoopla-74365640.description: Chain-free, recently refurbished eighth-floor flat with separate kitchen, private balcony, panoramic views, two bedrooms, shower room and separate WC, close to Finsbury Park and Stroud Green.

pros: Recently refurbished and chain free
Private balcony, views and separate kitchen
Within about ten minutes of Finsbury Park interchange
cons: Eighth floor; lift should be confirmed
All lease and running-cost terms are unpublished
Borderline rather than direct route

zoopla-74388345.tenure: Leasehold (974 years; £3,812 pa service charge; £387 ground rent)
zoopla-74388345.description: Chain-free 741 sq ft second-floor apartment with lift, balcony, allocated gated parking, communal gardens, two double bedrooms, two bathrooms and open-plan living.

pros: Two bathrooms, balcony, lift and allocated gated parking
Very long 974-year lease
£100k under budget
cons: High £3,812 pa service charge and £387 ground rent
Commute requires an interchange and is at the edge of the brief
Station walk is approximate

zoopla-74391906.description: Fourth-floor 607 sq ft two-bedroom flat with private terrace and church views, separate kitchen and bathroom, moments from Clissold Park and Church Street.

zoopla-74379284.description: Freehold three-bedroom terraced house arranged over two floors with two reception rooms, separate kitchen, family bathroom and private rear garden; the listing cites Bruce Grove and White Hart Lane stations.

zoopla-74355146.address: Acacia Road, Wood Green, London N22
zoopla-74355146.tenure: Leasehold (102 years; £2,230 pa service charge; £10 ground rent)
zoopla-74355146.description: Three-bedroom split-level second- and third-floor maisonette with two double bedrooms, one single bedroom, reception, kitchen-diner, bathroom and ground-floor storage shed. Wood Green Underground is stated as 0.5 miles away.

pros: Three bedrooms for £360k, leaving substantial budget headroom
Split-level layout and useful ground-floor storage
Station distance is within the requested limit
cons: £2,230 pa service charge and only 102 years on lease
Second/third-floor access
